descriptionByLocale.en:
Make scientific exchange matter
At Sobi, we work to improve the lives of people living with rare diseases. As our Medical Science Liaison (MSL) in haemophilia, you’ll build trusted scientific relationships and bring valuable insights to our medical work in Switzerland and across the region.
Working with colleagues across Medical Affairs and other functions, you’ll support high-quality scientific exchange, medical education and stakeholder engagement. You’ll also help ensure that local perspectives inform regional and global plans.
What you’ll do

• Build and maintain collaborative, peer-to-peer scientific relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), scientific experts, healthcare professionals and other medical stakeholders in haemophilia

• Deliver high-quality, balanced medical and scientific communication in line with approved communication plans and applicable requirements.

• Develop and execute stakeholder engagement plans to support meaningful scientific exchange.

• Independently initiate planned medical activities, including scientific presentations, discussion of clinical data and programs, presentation of medical value proposition concepts and educational programs.

• Work with Medical Affairs colleagues to develop and deliver medical education programs, scientific presentations and publications.

• Plan, organize and execute scientific advisory boards with appropriate stakeholders.

• Support the Swiss country team in developing local medical tactics, and contribute to regional and global plans where relevant.

• Collaborate with the local patient access team to support local access activities.

• Contribute medical and scientific expertise to local and regional initiatives, and provide local and regional feedback to Head Office.

• Support Head Office-led medical programs, investigator-sponsored studies (ISSs) and local studies, as appropriate.

• Coordinate medical information enquiries in collaboration with colleagues at Head Office in Stockholm.

• Attend relevant local, regional and global congresses and symposia, representing Sobi and engaging with appropriate stakeholders.

• Build relationships with scientific societies, relevant health authorities and other z, including hospitals and non-governmental organizations.

• Provide medical input to the organization and management, including advice on relevant legal and compliance considerations.

• Localize and adapt global medical slide decks to meet local requirements.

• Maintain timely, complete and compliant CRM documentation, and report in line with Sobi’s requirements and standards.
Keep your therapeutic-area knowledge current, including developments in haemophilia, treatment guidelines, products and the wider scientific landscape

About you
You bring scientific credibility, sound judgement and a collaborative approach to your work. You’re comfortable building professional relationships, communicating complex information clearly and working independently while contributing to shared goals.
You’ll also bring:

• A university degree in medicine, science, pharmacy, veterinary medicine or another relevant field that meets Swiss requirements for healthcare professional (HCP) interactions.

• At least two years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry.

• Fluency in German and English; French is an advantage.

• A strong understanding of the Swiss healthcare system and its decision-making environment, including relevant regulatory, safety, legal and compliance requirements.

• Confidence communicating scientific information and building relationships with KOLs and other stakeholders.

• Proficiency with modern IT and office software.

• Willingness to be in the field every day and including overnight business trips—typically one to three nights per month.
Experience in haemophilia, haematology, rare diseases or orphan drugs is an advantage. Experience in Medical Affairs, medical or clinical science, clinical development, market access, health economics, an international life sciences organisation, or new-product planning and launch activities would also be valuable.
How you work
You take initiative and responsibility, and you follow through on commitments. You’re structured, proactive and results-focused, while remaining considerate and adaptable in how you work with others.

You share knowledge, build useful networks and communicate with clarity and conviction. You bring empathy, integrity and professionalism to your interactions, and you can work with minimal supervision while staying closely connected to colleagues and stakeholders.

An international outlook and a constructive approach to working within company standards and procedures will help you thrive in this role.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Wissenschaftlichen Austausch wichtig machen
Bei Sobi arbeiten wir daran, das Leben von Menschen mit seltenen Krankheiten zu verbessern. Als Medical Science Liaison (MSL) für Hämophilie bauen Sie vertrauenswürdige wissenschaftliche Beziehungen auf und bringen wertvolle Einblicke in unsere medizinische Arbeit in der Schweiz und in der gesamten Region.
In Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus den Bereichen Medical Affairs und anderen Bereichen unterstützen Sie einen hochwertigen wissenschaftlichen Austausch, eine medizinische Ausbildung und das Engagement von Stakeholdern. Sie werden auch dazu beitragen, dass lokale Perspektiven regionale und globale Pläne informieren.
Was du tun wirst

• Aufbau und Pflege von kooperativen, Peer-to-Peer-wissenschaftlichen Beziehungen mit wichtigen Meinungsführern (KOLs), wissenschaftlichen Experten, medizinischen Fachkräften und anderen medizinischen Interessengruppen in der Hämophilie

• Arbeiten Sie mit Kollegen von Medical Affairs zusammen, um medizinische Bildungsprogramme, wissenschaftliche Präsentationen und Publikationen zu entwickeln und durchzuführen.

• Planen, organisieren und führen wissenschaftliche Beiräte mit den entsprechenden Stakeholdern durch.

• Unterstützen Sie das Schweizer Länderteam bei der Entwicklung lokaler medizinischer Taktiken und tragen Sie gegebenenfalls zu regionalen und globalen Plänen bei.

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem lokalen Patientenzugangsteam zusammen, um lokale Zugangsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.

• Bringen Sie medizinische und wissenschaftliche Expertise zu lokalen und regionalen Initiativen bei und geben Sie lokales und regionales Feedback an die Zentrale.

• Führen Sie eine zeitnahe, vollständige und konforme CRM-Dokumentation und berichten Sie gemäß den Anforderungen und Standards von Sobi.

Sie bringen wissenschaftliche Glaubwürdigkeit, fundiertes Urteilsvermögen und einen kooperativen Ansatz in Ihre Arbeit. Sie fühlen sich wohl dabei, professionelle Beziehungen aufzubauen, komplexe Informationen klar zu kommunizieren und unabhängig zu arbeiten, während Sie zu gemeinsamen Zielen beitragen.
Sie bringen auch:

• Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in der Pharmaindustrie.

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch; Französisch ist ein Vorteil.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis des Schweizer Gesundheitssystems und seines Entscheidungsumfelds, einschließlich relevanter regulatorischer, sicherheitsrelevanter, rechtlicher und Compliance-Anforderungen.

• Vertrauen in die Vermittlung wissenschaftlicher Informationen und Aufbau von Beziehungen zu KOLs und anderen Interessengruppen.

• Kenntnisse in moderner IT- und Bürosoftware.

• Bereitschaft, jeden Tag vor Ort zu sein, einschließlich Geschäftsreisen über Nacht - normalerweise ein bis drei Nächte pro Monat.

Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Medizin, Medizin oder klinische Wissenschaft, klinische Entwicklung, Marktzugang, Gesundheitsökonomie, einer internationalen Organisation für Biowissenschaften oder Planung und Einführung neuer Produkte wären ebenfalls wertvoll.
Wie Sie arbeiten
Sie übernehmen Initiative und Verantwortung und halten die Verpflichtungen ein. Sie sind strukturiert, proaktiv und ergebnisorientiert, während Sie rücksichtsvoll und anpassungsfähig bleiben, wie Sie mit anderen arbeiten.

Sie teilen Wissen, bauen nützliche Netzwerke auf und kommunizieren mit Klarheit und Überzeugung. Sie bringen Empathie, Integrität und Professionalität in Ihre Interaktionen, und Sie können mit minimaler Aufsicht arbeiten, während Sie eng mit Kollegen und Stakeholdern verbunden bleiben.

Eine internationale Perspektive und ein konstruktiver Ansatz für die Arbeit innerhalb der Unternehmensstandards und -verfahren werden Ihnen helfen, in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Faire des échanges scientifiques matière
Chez Sobi, nous travaillons à améliorer la vie des personnes vivant avec des maladies rares. En tant que notre Liaison en sciences médicales (MSL) en hémophilie, vous établirez des relations scientifiques de confiance et apporterez de précieuses idées à notre travail médical en Suisse et dans toute la région.
En travaillant avec des collègues des Affaires médicales et d'autres fonctions, vous soutiendrez les échanges scientifiques de haute qualité, l'éducation médicale et l'engagement des parties prenantes. Vous contribuerez également à ce que les perspectives locales éclairent les plans régionaux et mondiaux.
Ce que vous allez faire

• Établir et maintenir des relations scientifiques collaboratives entre pairs avec les principaux leaders de l'opinion, les experts scientifiques, les professionnels de la santé et d'autres intervenants médicaux en hémophilie

• Fournir une communication médicale et scientifique de haute qualité, équilibrée et conforme aux plans de communication approuvés et aux exigences applicables.

• Élaborer et exécuter des plans de participation des intervenants pour appuyer des échanges scientifiques significatifs.

• Indépendantement, entreprendre des activités médicales planifiées, y compris des présentations scientifiques, des discussions sur les données et les programmes cliniques, la présentation des concepts de proposition de valeur médicale et des programmes éducatifs.

• Collaborer avec des collègues des Affaires médicales à l'élaboration et à la prestation de programmes de formation médicale, de présentations scientifiques et de publications.

• Planifier, organiser et exécuter des conseils consultatifs scientifiques avec les intervenants appropriés.

• Aider l'équipe de pays suisse à élaborer des tactiques médicales locales et contribuer, le cas échéant, aux plans régionaux et mondiaux.

• Collaborer avec l'équipe locale d'accès aux patients pour appuyer les activités d'accès local.

• Fournir une expertise médicale et scientifique aux initiatives locales et régionales et fournir une rétroaction locale et régionale au siège social.

• Appuyer les programmes médicaux dirigés par le siège social, les études parrainées par les chercheurs et les études locales, selon le cas.

• Coordonner les demandes de renseignements médicaux en collaboration avec des collègues du siège social de Stockholm.

• Participer aux congrès et colloques locaux, régionaux et mondiaux pertinents, représenter Sobi et collaborer avec les parties prenantes appropriées.

• Établir des relations avec les sociétés scientifiques, les autorités sanitaires compétentes et d'autres z, y compris les hôpitaux et les organisations non gouvernementales.

• Fournir des conseils médicaux à l'organisation et à la direction, y compris des conseils sur les aspects juridiques et de conformité pertinents.

• Localiser et adapter les plates-formes médicales globales pour répondre aux besoins locaux.

• Maintenir la documentation CRM en temps opportun, complète et conforme et faire rapport conformément aux exigences et aux normes de Sobi.
Gardez vos connaissances thérapeutiques à jour, y compris les développements dans l'hémophilie, les lignes directrices de traitement, les produits et le paysage scientifique plus large

Sur toi
Vous apportez une crédibilité scientifique, un jugement solide et une approche collaborative de votre travail. Vous êtes à l'aise pour établir des relations professionnelles, communiquer des informations complexes clairement et travailler indépendamment tout en contribuant à des objectifs partagés.
Vous apporterez également:

• Diplôme universitaire en médecine, science, pharmacie, médecine vétérinaire ou autre domaine pertinent qui répond aux exigences suisses en matière d'interactions entre professionnels de la santé (HCP).

• Au moins deux ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.

• La maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais; le français est un avantage.

• Une bonne compréhension du système de santé suisse et de son environnement décisionnel, y compris les exigences réglementaires, de sécurité, juridiques et de conformité.

• La confiance dans la communication de l'information scientifique et l'établissement de relations avec les KOL et d'autres intervenants.

• Compétence avec les logiciels informatiques et de bureau modernes.

• Volonté d'être sur le terrain tous les jours et y compris les voyages d'affaires de nuit – généralement une à trois nuits par mois.
L'expérience en hémophilie, en hématologie, en maladies rares ou en médicaments orphelins est un avantage. L'expérience en affaires médicales, en sciences médicales ou cliniques, en développement clinique, en accès au marché, en économie de santé, en organisation internationale des sciences de la vie ou en planification et lancement de nouveaux produits serait également précieuse.

Vous prenez l'initiative et la responsabilité, et vous suivez les engagements. Vous êtes structuré, proactif et axé sur les résultats, tout en restant attentif et adaptable dans votre façon de travailler avec les autres.

Vous partagez vos connaissances, créez des réseaux utiles et communiquez avec clarté et conviction. Vous apportez empathie, intégrité et professionnalisme à vos interactions, et vous pouvez travailler avec une supervision minimale tout en restant étroitement lié à vos collègues et intervenants.

Une perspective internationale et une approche constructive du travail au sein des normes et procédures de l'entreprise vous aideront à s'épanouir dans ce rôle.

Come applicare
Abbiamo un processo di selezione in corso in questo reclutamento e vi chiediamo di inviare la vostra domanda il prima possibile. Fare clic su applicare e includere il tuo curriculum in inglese.
Perché unirsi a noi?
Qui a Sobi, la nostra missione e la nostra cultura ci eccitano a venire al lavoro ogni giorno, ma qui ci sono alcune altre ragioni per unirsi al nostro team:

• L'enfasi sul bilanciamento del lavoro/vita

• Ambiente collaborativo e orientato al team

• Opportunità di crescita professionale

• Diversità e inclusione

• Compensazione competitiva per il tuo lavoro

• Fare un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti con malattie ultra rare che hanno bisogno di trattamenti di salvataggio
Sobi è una società globale con oltre 2000 dipendenti in oltre 30 paesi e si impegnano nelle società in cui operiamo. Siamo un'azienda biofarmaceutica internazionale specializzata che trasforma la vita di persone con malattie rare e debilitanti, fornendo un accesso affidabile a farmaci innovativi nelle aree di ematologia, immunologia e cura delle specialità. La quota di Sobi è elencata su Nasdaq Stockholm. Maggiori informazioni su Sobi a sobi.com e LinkedIn.

Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono il nostro bene più prezioso e la nostra cultura lo trasmette. Offriamo un pacchetto di benefici competitivi, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale.

Sobi Cultura

A Sobi, ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché abbiamo assistito in prima persona alle sfide che le persone colpite da malattie rare e abbiamo usato questa conoscenza per plasmare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi di aiutarli.

Come azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, siamo dedicati a malattie rare. E vediamo questo focus come una forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, aiutiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e aprire più possibilità per i pazienti e più opportunità per coloro che li curano. Questo è stato il nostro approccio fin dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo di malattie rare da soli. L'integrazione richiede forti partnership con pazienti, partner e stakeholder in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come il nostro business può creare soluzioni che servono le esigenze di coloro che sono colpiti da malattie rare, facilitando la crescita sostenibile.

Sobi-Kultur

jobs.description:
Introduction/Purpose:
 The position holder will be office based and is expected to travel occasionally for internal and external meetings, trainings and conferences. It will be the responsibility of the position holder to help develop the presence and recognition of Sobi as a credible partner within the rare disease community through supporting the development of relationships with key stakeholders (especially physicians), as well as authorities and patient access colleagues as well as DACH and HQ staff in a cross functional approach to Sobi’s interactions with all stakeholders (physicians, payers, nurses and patients).
 Objective for the company:
 Propose and implement market access strategies and tactics for all Sobi products that are already launched and marketed in the DACH region in light of the current applicable regulations and the expectations of the health authorities, customers and patients organizations.
 Key Responsibilities:

• Work closely with the local cross-functional product teams as well as with the National Sales Managers to identify pricing and positioning opportunities as well as threats for the Haemophilia franchise, Haematology and Immunology products.

• Strong collaboration with finance, sales and patient access to manage existing and develop new pricing and reimbursement offers and the impact from an economical perspective

• Monitor competitive environment and develop appropriate pricing and contracting strategies for marketed Sobi products to support commercial business goals

• Execute and negotiate pricing and contracting strategies with relevant stakeholders as sick funds or physician associations where needed

• Produce and analyse contract/payer specific reports

• Develop consultative relationships with key decision makers and stakeholders and leverage Sobi as the preferred partner for innovative contracting models

• Identify national and regional authorities and stakeholders with responsibility for the pricing and reimbursement of existing and new products and engage appropriately with such bodies together with the Director Patient Access & Engagement DACH to understand requirements and support for optimal pricing and reimbursement

• Proactively track key legislative changes and sick fund related changes with potential impact on Sobi’s business

• Develop and drive local real-world evidence and HEOR strategy as well as respective publication plan to demonstrate reliable insights of health care reality and benefits of modern therapy approaches

• Liase with Marketing and Patient Access to drive materials, fact sheets, cost calculators and other selling tools

• Support the AMNOG process for Sobi’s pre-launch products by shaping reimbursement strategies, dossiers and benefit assessment process in close collaboration with the pre-launch Patient Access team

• Propose, coordinate and lead AMNOG negotiations with GKV-SV in close collaboration with the pre-launch Patient Access team

Education

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare, Economics, Public Health, or a related field

• Recent graduates are welcome to apply
 Experience

• Academic experience in market access, health economics, pricing & reimbursement, or healthcare policy is an advantage but not required

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.
 Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Introduzione/Scopo:

La persona che ricoprirà la posizione lavorerà in ufficio e dovrà viaggiare occasionalmente per riunioni interne ed esterne, corsi di formazione e conferenze. Sarà responsabilità della persona che ricoprirà la posizione contribuire a sviluppare la presenza e il riconoscimento di Sobi come partner credibile nella comunità delle malattie rare, sostenendo lo sviluppo di relazioni con i principali stakeholder (in particolare i medici), nonché con le autorità e i colleghi dell'accesso dei pazienti, oltre che con il personale DACH e HQ, adottando un approccio interfunzionale alle interazioni di Sobi con tutti gli stakeholder (medici, enti pagatori, infermieri e pazienti).

Obiettivo per l'azienda:

Proporre e implementare strategie e tattiche di accesso al mercato per tutti i prodotti Sobi già lanciati e commercializzati nella regione DACH alla luce delle normative vigenti e delle aspettative delle autorità sanitarie, dei clienti e delle organizzazioni dei pazienti.

Principali responsabilità:

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di prodotto locali interfunzionali e con i responsabili nazionali delle vendite per individuare opportunità e minacce in materia di prezzi e posizionamento per la franchise dell'emofilia e i prodotti di ematologia e immunologia.
- Stretta collaborazione con le funzioni finanziaria, commerciale e di accesso dei pazienti per gestire le offerte esistenti, sviluppare nuove proposte di prezzo e rimborso e gestirne l'impatto dal punto di vista economico
- Monitorare l'ambiente competitivo e sviluppare strategie appropriate di prezzo e contrattualizzazione per i prodotti Sobi commercializzati, a sostegno degli obiettivi commerciali dell'azienda
- Attuare e negoziare strategie di prezzo e contrattualizzazione con gli stakeholder pertinenti, quali le casse malattia o le associazioni dei medici, ove necessario
- Produrre e analizzare report specifici per contratto/pagatore
- Sviluppare relazioni di consulenza con i principali decisori e stakeholder e valorizzare Sobi come partner preferenziale per modelli contrattuali innovativi
- Identificare le autorità e gli stakeholder nazionali e regionali responsabili della determinazione dei prezzi e del rimborso dei prodotti esistenti e nuovi e interagire adeguatamente con tali enti insieme al Direttore dell'accesso dei pazienti e del coinvolgimento DACH per comprendere i requisiti e fornire supporto per ottenere condizioni ottimali di prezzo e rimborso
- Seguire proattivamente le principali modifiche legislative e quelle relative alle casse malattia, con un potenziale impatto sull'attività di Sobi
- Sviluppare e guidare la strategia locale relativa alle evidenze del mondo reale e all'HEOR, nonché il relativo piano di pubblicazione, per dimostrare conoscenze affidabili sulla realtà dell'assistenza sanitaria e sui benefici degli approcci terapeutici moderni
- Interfacciarsi con il Marketing e l'Accesso dei pazienti per sviluppare materiali, schede informative, calcolatori dei costi e altri strumenti di vendita
- Supportare il processo AMNOG per i prodotti Sobi in fase di pre-lancio, definendo le strategie di rimborso, i dossier e il processo di valutazione dei benefici in stretta collaborazione con il team di accesso dei pazienti pre-lancio
- Proporre, coordinare e guidare le negoziazioni AMNOG con GKV-SV in stretta collaborazione con il team di accesso dei pazienti pre-lancio

Formazione

- Laurea triennale o magistrale in Scienze della vita, Farmacia, assistenza sanitaria, Economia, Sanità pubblica o in un campo correlato
- I neolaureati sono invitati a candidarsi

Esperienza

- Un'esperienza accademica nell'accesso al mercato, nell'economia sanitaria, nella determinazione dei prezzi e dei rimborsi o nelle politiche sanitarie costituisce un vantaggio, ma non è richiesta

Tutti i dipendenti di Sobi devono dimostrare comportamenti in linea con i valori fondamentali di Sobi: Cura, Ambizione, Urgenza, Responsabilità e Collaborazione. Sei pronto/a a far parte del team Sobi? Vieni a far parte di una cultura che mette ogni persona nella condizione di fare la differenza per le malattie rare.

Perché unirsi a noi?

Siamo un'azienda globale con oltre 1,900 dipendenti in più di 30 Paesi e ci impegniamo a favore delle comunità in cui operiamo. Con un team dirigenziale di grande competenza che guida i nostri successi quotidiani e un Consiglio di amministrazione con un curriculum eccezionale, siamo pronti ad affrontare le malattie, le patologie e le avversità del mondo. Le nostre persone credono di avere il potere di incidere positivamente sulla vita degli altri, perché è esattamente ciò che facciamo qui. Se cerchi una carriera che valorizzi i tuoi talenti in modo da rendere il mondo un luogo migliore e più sano, potremmo avere proprio un lavoro per te.

Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra risorsa più preziosa e la nostra cultura lo dimostra. Offriamo un pacchetto di benefit competitivo, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale.

Cultura di Sobi

In Sobi, rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché abbiamo visto in prima persona le sfide che devono affrontare le persone colpite da malattie rare e abbiamo utilizzato questa conoscenza per dare forma alla nostra attività e trovare nuovi modi per aiutarle.

In qualità di azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, ci dedichiamo alle malattie rare. E consideriamo questa focalizzazione un punto di forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti all'avanguardia, contribuiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e ad aprire più possibilità per i pazienti e più opportunità per coloro che si prendono cura di loro. Questo è stato il nostro approccio fin dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo di non poter cambiare da soli il mondo delle malattie rare. Realizzare tutto ciò richiede solide collaborazioni con pazienti, partner e stakeholder lungo l'intera catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come la nostra attività possa creare soluzioni che rispondano alle esigenze delle persone colpite da malattie rare, favorendo al contempo una crescita sostenibile.

Un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità

Sobi è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità e vieta ogni forma di discriminazione e molestia. Tutte le decisioni relative all'impiego presso Sobi si basano sulle esigenze aziendali, sui requisiti della posizione e sulle qualifiche individuali, senza riguardo a razza, colore, religione o credo, origine nazionale, sociale o etnica, sesso (compresa la gravidanza), età, disabilità fisica, mentale o sensoriale, stato sierologico relativo all'HIV, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, status di veterano protetto e/o espressione, stato matrimoniale, di unione civile o di convivenza di fatto, servizio militare passato o presente, storia medica familiare o informazioni genetiche, condizione familiare o genitoriale, o qualsiasi altro status o gruppo protetto dalle leggi o dai regolamenti nei luoghi in cui operiamo.

Sobi è un datore di lavoro che applica politiche di azione positiva e garantisce pari opportunità. Persone con disabilità/Veterani. Se sei una persona qualificata con disabilità o un veterano con disabilità, puoi richiedere un accomodamento ragionevole se, a causa della tua disabilità, non sei in grado di utilizzare o accedere a questo sito web per candidarti a una posizione vacante, oppure hai capacità limitate nel farlo. Puoi richiedere accomodamenti ragionevoli inviando un'e-mail a talentacquisition@sobi.com.

Die Position ist im Büro angesiedelt, und es werden gelegentliche Reisen zu internen und externen Besprechungen, Schulungen und Konferenzen erwartet. Zu den Aufgaben der Position gehört es, dazu beizutragen, dass Sobi innerhalb der Community für seltene Erkrankungen als glaubwürdiger Partner an Präsenz und Bekanntheit gewinnt, indem der Aufbau von Beziehungen zu wichtigen Stakeholdern (insbesondere Ärztinnen und Ärzten) sowie zu Behörden, Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Bereich Patient Access und Mitarbeitenden in DACH und HQ im Rahmen eines funktionsübergreifenden Ansatzes für die Interaktionen von Sobi mit allen Stakeholdern (Ärztinnen und Ärzten, Kostenträgern, Pflegekräften und Patientinnen und Patienten) unterstützt wird.

Ziel für das Unternehmen:

Marktzugangsstrategien und -taktiken für alle Sobi-Produkte, die in der DACH-Region bereits eingeführt und vermarktet werden, vor dem Hintergrund der aktuell geltenden Vorschriften und der Erwartungen der Gesundheitsbehörden, Kunden und Patientenorganisationen vorschlagen und umsetzen.

Hauptaufgaben:

- Eng mit den lokalen funktionsübergreifenden Produktteams sowie mit den nationalen Vertriebsleitern zusammenarbeiten, um Chancen und Risiken in Bezug auf Preisgestaltung und Positionierung für das Hämophilie-Franchise sowie für Produkte aus den Bereichen Hämatologie und Immunologie zu identifizieren.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Finanzen, Vertrieb und Patient Access, um bestehende Preis- und Erstattungsangebote zu verwalten, neue zu entwickeln und deren wirtschaftliche Auswirkungen zu bewerten.
- Das Wettbewerbsumfeld beobachten und geeignete Preis- und Vertragsstrategien für die vermarkteten Sobi-Produkte entwickeln, um die kommerziellen Geschäftsziele zu unterstützen.
- Preis- und Vertragsstrategien bei Bedarf mit relevanten Stakeholdern wie Krankenkassen oder Ärzteverbänden umsetzen und verhandeln.
- Vertrags- bzw. kostenträgerspezifische Berichte erstellen und analysieren.

Proposer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies et tactiques d’accès au marché pour tous les produits de Sobi déjà lancés et commercialisés dans la région DACH, compte tenu de la réglementation actuellement applicable et des attentes des autorités sanitaires, des clients et des organisations de patients.

jobs.description:
As External Quality Operation Manager (EQOM), you will play a central role in ensuring strong quality oversight of external manufacturing partners and supporting the reliable supply of high‑quality medicines. Acting as the main quality interface with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Sobi in a fast‑moving, global environment.
 This is a hands‑on role combining operational responsibility with continuous improvement. You will help ensure compliance, strengthen partnerships and contribute to developing efficient, future‑ready ways of working.
 This position is a Hybrid role, based in our Global Hub in Basel Switzerland or Headquarter in Stockholm, Sweden reporting directly to the Associate Director, External Quality Operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform as EQOM to act as Single point of contact for all quality related activities at the Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO)

• Ensure that all aspects of handling, manufacturing, distribution of products are in compliance with Sobi Quality system, the effective Quality Technical Agreement, that they meet relevant CGMP regulatory requirement.

• Support the products release by acting as QP Delegate according to delegation documents, when necessary

• Support the External Service Provider (CMO) Qualification

• Ensure Quality Technical Agreement (QTA) be established appropriately and ensure valid QTA clearly defines roles & responsibilities between Sobi and the External Supplier

• Ensure implementation and maintaining Quality Risk Assessment and KPIs on Quality External activities. Guide defining & monitoring remediation plans to ensure that issues are suitably addressed. Drive or support improvement opportunities for processes and product Quality performance

• Ensure CMO provides product reviews or data (APQR/PQRs, stability reports) as specified in the QTA. Assess the performance of the product and the process as per Sobi requirement

• Manage/approve quality issues (deviations, CAPA and complaints) as per QTA and Sobi requirement

• Ensure that Change requests either from CMO or from Sobi are managed according to the QTA and Sobi requirements

• Support that Quality Audits of the CMO is performed according to Sobi requirement and the QTA

• Lead to define strategy of implementation and monitoring of key Quality transformation initiatives and align with all process stakeholders outside of Quality organization

• Lead or act as Quality representative in project related to CMO eg Tech Transfer, Launch

• Assess and ensure CMO readiness for Health Authorities (HAs) inspection

• Support HA inspections/audits of Sobi

• Responsible to inform the line manager and cross functional teams of all critical & major issues and escalate any issues as per Sobi escalation policy

• Ensure a good collaboration is maintained within the Global Quality Operations and cross-functionally

You thrive in a dynamic, international environment where priorities evolve and collaboration is essential. You are proactive, flexible and comfortable taking ownership, with the ability to balance operational detail and a broader quality perspective.
 You enjoy building strong relationships, influencing external partners and working cross‑functionally to find practical solutions. Open to change and new ways of working, you bring energy, structure and a continuous‑improvement mindset — and you are motivated by the opportunity to make a real difference for patients.
 Key Qualifications
 Required:

• High level education (university degree or similar) within relevant area such as pharmaceutical, biotech or life science

• More than 5 years of experience within pharmaceutical, biotech product. Experience in QA operation, production or other relevant area (GMP, GDP)

• More than 1 years of managing external quality oversight of CMOs

• Curriculum is requested for evaluating the batch release qualification requirement

• Fluently spoken and written English
 Desired:

• More than 2 years of working in global operation environment with English as a main language

• Proven experience of leading Quality KPI assessment and improvement at CMOs

• Proven track record with FDA; EMEA or other Health Authorities

• Strong understanding of risk assessment and risk management fundamentals / tools
 Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English
 Why Join Us?
 We are differentiating ourselves through the passion of our people, the innovative products we bring to life, and the responsible business we operate.
 To ensure that more patients benefit from our therapies now and in the future, and to align with the company’s ambitions for growth, we have five core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership.
 Our mission and purpose get us excited to come to work every day, but there are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Diversity and Inclusion

• A flexible workplace that supports work-life balance
 About Sobi
 Sobi is a global biopharma company unlocking the potential of breakthrough innovations, transforming everyday life for people living with rare diseases.
 We are dedicated to capturing the scientific opportunities of our time. With our early roots in Sweden, we started as pioneers in Haemophilia. Today we are an innovate leader within rare diseases with a global reach.

• We are bringing brilliant ideas to life in rare disease areas with high unmet patient needs.

• We are experts on identifying breakthrough innovations, unlocking new therapies and levelling up global access to new treatments.

• Our global operational network and passionate team serve as the foundation for our success.
 Sobi has approximately 2,000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, Asia and Australia. In 2025, revenue amounted to SEK 28 billion. Sobi’s share (STO:SOBI) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

• Sostegno Ispezioni HA/audit di Sobi

• Responsabile di informare il responsabile della linea e di incrociare i team funzionali di tutte le questioni critiche e importanti ed escalare qualsiasi problema secondo la politica di escalation Sobi

Si prospera in un ambiente dinamico e internazionale in cui le priorità si evolvono e la collaborazione è essenziale. Siete proattivi, flessibili e confortevoli, con la capacità di bilanciare i dettagli operativi e una prospettiva di qualità più ampia.

• Più di 5 anni di esperienza all'interno del prodotto farmaceutico e biotecnologico. Esperienza nell'operazione QA, produzione o altro settore rilevante (GMP, PIL)

• Più di 1 anni di gestione della supervisione della qualità esterna dei CMO

Guide définissant et surveillant les plans d'assainissement pour s'assurer que les questions sont traitées de façon appropriée. • Soutien que les audits de qualité de l'OCM sont effectués conformément aux exigences de Sobi et à la QTA

• Diriger la définition de la stratégie de mise en oeuvre et de suivi des principales initiatives de transformation de la qualité et s'aligner avec tous les intervenants du processus à l'extérieur de l'organisation Qualité

• Diriger ou agir en tant que représentant de la qualité dans le cadre de projets liés au transfert, au lancement et au transfert de technologie de l'OCM

• Évaluer et assurer la préparation des OCM à l'inspection des autorités sanitaires (HA)

• Soutenir les inspections/audits des AP de Sobi

• Responsable d'informer le gestionnaire de ligne et les équipes interfonctionnelles de toutes les questions critiques et majeures et d'intensifier les questions selon la politique d'escalade de Sobi

• Veiller à ce qu'une bonne collaboration soit maintenue au sein des opérations de qualité mondiale et interfonctionnelle

• Plus de 5 ans d'expérience au sein du produit pharmaceutique et biotechnologique. Expérience en matière d'exploitation, de production ou d'autres domaines pertinents (BPF, PIB)

jobs.description:
Sobi is currently seeking an experienced Senior Toxicologist, Non-Clinical Pharmacology Scientist to join our Preclinical Development and Translational Medicine (PDTM) Department. The selected candidate will be responsible for the Toxicology and Non-Clinical Pharmacology activities within projects to support Clinical and Core Asset Teams for products under development or geographic expansion of established products.
 Key Responsibilities

• Define appropriate strategies for Toxicology and Non-Clinical Pharmacology in assigned projects

• Overall accountability for Toxicology and Non-Clinical Pharmacology strategies and activities in appointed projects

• Provide expert knowledge in Toxicology and Non-Clinical Pharmacology to the cross-functional teams

• Responsible for Toxicology and Non-Clinical pharmacology modules and sections in regulatory documents (including IB, summaries for IND and IMPD, RMP, briefing documentation)

• Responsible for interactions with regulatory authorities for all questions related to non-clinical pharmacology and Toxicology for assigned projects

• Manage preclinical safety studies in Contract Research Organizations: design, monitor, discuss and report the safety findings

• Ensure translational aspects are taken into account and optimally used and integrated as well as any safety alerts emerging from literature or Toxicology studies are communicated and discussed within the Benefit/risk team

• Perform all required Toxicology assessments for impurities in the drug products or to support questions from manufacturing sites

• Participate in internal and external scientific communications (oral presentations, posters, publication)

• PhD, DVM or equivalent in relevant discipline with a minimum of five year experience as a project toxicologist, with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects across various development stages.

• Experience with biologics and small molecules is required, while experience with oligonucleotides, gene therapy, or combination drugs is a strong plus.

• Board certification such as a DABT/ERT is a plus
 Skills & Competencies

• Extensive regulatory toxicology experience and solid understanding of the drug-development process, including late stage and life cycle management for established compounds is required

• Experience in immunotoxicology is a plus

• Excellent communication and presentation skills - Fluency in written and spoken English

• Energetic, driven and able to take initiative with a “can-do attitude”

• Results and delivery focused as well as a structured way of working

• Good problem-solving ability and analytical mindset

• Strong sense of personal accountability working independently as well as a strong ability to work in teams.

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi
 At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.
 All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.
 Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.
